title: docs(skills): point spec-property-retirement at the split conversions layout
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x7awHcehzTyBghDMuazAhzx)_

Fixes #29994

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The maintainer waived the model-tier mandate for governed rule text while that tier had no quota; this PR was developed below it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §3 的两步改指 #29993 拆分后的布局。conversion 那步写明「单独一个模块 `conversions/entries/<toMajor>/<id>.ts`,按名 export;手写提交、无生成器的 `registry.ts` 只加 import」;18 步那句写明在 `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` 按标识符插入 `{ conversion, order }`,import 放在后继条目的 import 正上方。
- 为什么改:#29993 把 `conversions/registry.ts` 拆成每条一个模块后,技能仍教人在 `registry.ts` 里写 conversion 本体。
- 风险与回滚:只改内部技能文字(Tier H,不进 `@objectstack/skills`),行数仍 337(上限 337);回滚即 revert。
- 先看:L176-180 与 L216-217;以及为守行数上限删掉的 §4 L263 一行(见下)。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`.claude/**`),需要 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 的批准;PR 保持 draft。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`, §3 (registration surface):

- **The `MetadataConversion` step (L176-180).** It used to say the conversion is written in `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`. It now says each conversion is a module of its own at `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/<toMajor>/<id>.ts`, the file named for the `id` and the conversion exported by name, and that `registry.ts` only gains its import. It also says `registry.ts` is hand-written and committed, with no generator. The shared `stripKeys` helper is now located at `entries/shared.ts`. The rest of the step (id suffix, `emit` per key, `fixture.expectedNotices`, the walkers in `walk.ts`, copy-on-write) is unchanged. These six lines were re-flowed because their content changed; L181 is byte-identical.
- **The step-18 note in the D3 chain step (L216-217).** It used to say "insert into `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` sorted by identifier". It now names the line, `{ conversion, order }`, inserted by identifier as the list's header says, and where its import goes: directly above the import of the entry that follows it. The header comment still speaks of the *definition's* place; since the split, the merge test reads that place as the import (`packages/spec/scripts/conversions-major18-merge.test.ts` L26-31), so the line says so. L215 and L218 onward are byte-identical.

Read off `main` at `f68b47ca`: the layout of `conversions/entries/`, the codemod `scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs` (one-shot, not a generator: `entries/<toMajor>/<id>.ts` read off the conversion's own `id` literal), the `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` header comment, and the merge test's header. Unlike the migrations registry the step above describes (`registry.ts.template` + `gen:migration-registry`, git-ignored output), the conversions `registry.ts` is committed and hand-edited (the merge test: "The file is hand-written, so nothing regenerates it").

**Line ceiling.** `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` pins this file at 337 lines with 0 headroom. The step-18 note grew by one line, which is paid by deleting §4's L263 「「改了 X → 重新生成 Y」的表见 AGENTS.md。」. That is a duplicate pointer: L33-35 already sends the reader to AGENTS.md §"Touched `packages/spec`?", which is where that table lives (AGENTS.md L650-660), and L330 points there again. No line was re-wrapped to make room.

**Changeset.** `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0 with no changeset. The diff is `.claude/**` only and releases nothing, so this PR takes `skip-changeset` (pr-automation.yml route 2).

## Why

PR #29993 (#29987) split `conversions/registry.ts` into per-entry modules and filed this follow-up in its body: the skill still tells devs to write a new conversion inside `registry.ts`.

## Verification

Head `68373420`, one commit on `f68b47ca`.

<details><summary>Local gates on 68373420: 19 derived, 19 run with exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED (`dispatch-gates --ran`)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 19 commands for the one changed file. All ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a `turbo run build` of `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql` (both exit 0), each under a 900 s timeout with its exit code captured before any pipe.
- All 19 exited 0, among them `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:ci-filter-parity`.
- The artifact rosters `pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster` (roster under `.claude`) and `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` both exited 0.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts`, which reads this SKILL.md: 15 of 15 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0 (337 lines, ceiling 337).
- `--ran` printed: `19 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` and `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

</details>

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No names added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `.claude/**` only; `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section and the skill text are Chinese, as the file is.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
